Conversation.title: Conversation
Conversation.description: A user's AI chat conversation thread.

userId.description: Authenticated Firebase UID of the conversation owner.

title.description: Display title of the conversation (1 to 120 characters).

modelMode.description: Selected Gemini AI assistant mode for this conversation.

lastMessagePreview.description: Truncated preview of the latest message (up to 200 characters).

messageCount.description: Number of messages in the conversation.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when conversation was created (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when conversation was last updated (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

ChatMessage.title: ChatMessage
ChatMessage.description: An individual message within a conversation.

userId.description: Authenticated Firebase UID of the owner.

thoughtText.description: Optional reasoning summary when High Thinking mode is enabled.

modelId.description: Gemini model identifier used to produce or handle this message.

sources.description: Optional search grounding source citations (up to 10).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when message was persisted (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

/users/{userId}/conversations/{conversat.description: Messages belonging to a user's conversation.
